headline: Ethereum bridged token verified on Etherscan; recognized-firm audits referenced but PDFs inaccessible; no public source repository found

findings.text: Ethereum token 0x0C10bF8FcB7Bf5412187A595ab97a3609160b5c6 is verified on Etherscan (abiSource: 'etherscan', verified: true). The contract is not a proxy (proxy: null), so only one contract requires verification. The BNB Chain token (0xd17479997f34dd9156deef8f95a52d81d265be9c) could not be independently verified because BSC (chain 56) is listed in the DeFiPunkd read-API supported chain list but no on-chain fetch succeeded for it in this run.

No public GitHub repository for USDD smart contracts was found. The protocol.github field is empty and a targeted GitHub search returned no USDD-specific source repository. Source-to-repo correspondence cannot be established. This is a material gap: the verified Etherscan source cannot be cross-referenced against a public repo or commit SHA.

USDD's own communications (Medium post dated Oct 30, 2025) describe a fifth audit by ChainSecurity covering Ethereum and BNB Chain deployments, plus a CertiK audit of the Ethereum deployment in September 2025. The audit index page (https://docs.usdd.io/security/audits) was inaccessible (403). No audit PDFs were retrieved, so specific contract addresses and commit SHAs in scope could not be confirmed from primary sources.

ChainSecurity and CertiK are broadly recognized Solidity auditing firms. ChainSecurity appears in the rubric's recognized-firm list. CertiK is widely referenced across the industry. The use of two recognized firms across five audit rounds is a positive signal.

Post-audit drift cannot be assessed because no public source repository exists. Without a repo to diff against the deployed bytecode or the audited commit, the gap between the audited codebase and the live deployment is unknown.
The Ethereum token is not a proxy (proxy: null per DeFiPunkd ABI API). There is no separate implementation contract to verify. V6 is therefore satisfied for the Ethereum deployment.

steelman.red: No public GitHub repository was found for USDD contracts, meaning the deployed bytecode cannot be matched against any open-source codebase, which is a core red-grade criterion.
steelman.orange: The Ethereum token is verified on Etherscan and is a non-proxy immutable contract; multiple audits by ChainSecurity (recognized firm) and CertiK covering the current Ethereum deployment were completed within 6 months of the analysis date, but the absence of a public source repo prevents confirming source-to-repo correspondence and post-audit drift.
steelman.green: A consistent series of five audits by recognized firms (ChainSecurity, CertiK) covering the exact EVM deployments, combined with verified Etherscan source, would qualify for green if a public repo were available to confirm source correspondence.

rationale.verdict: Choosing orange because the Ethereum token is verified on Etherscan and recent audits by recognized firms (ChainSecurity October 2025, CertiK September 2025) are referenced, satisfying V1, V4, and V6 for the Ethereum deployment. However, the absence of any public GitHub source repository (V2 gap) prevents source-to-repo correspondence, and the audit PDFs are inaccessible so specific in-scope contract addresses and commit SHAs cannot be confirmed (V3 partial). The BNB Chain deployment could not be independently verified in this run. These gaps — particularly no public repo — keep the assessment below green.

evidence.shows: Ethereum token 0x0C10bF8FcB7Bf5412187A595ab97a3609160b5c6 surfacer: ABI source = 'etherscan', name = 'Decentralized USD', symbol = 'USDD', decimals = 18, not a proxy. Reads pinned to block 25046046.
JSON response confirms verified: true, abiSource: 'etherscan', proxy: null, contractName: 'USDD'. No proxy resolution needed.

USDD Medium post (Oct 30, 2025) confirms: fifth ChainSecurity audit covering Ethereum and BNB Chain deployments; CertiK audit of Ethereum USDD in September 2025; four prior audits by ChainSecurity and CertiK; audit reports available at https://docs.usdd.io/security/audits.

unknowns: V2: No public GitHub repository found for USDD smart contracts — source-to-repo correspondence and commit SHA pinning cannot be performed. A targeted GitHub search returned no USDD-specific repo; protocol.github is empty.
V3: Audit PDFs at https://docs.usdd.io/security/audits were inaccessible (403 error) — specific contracts and commit SHAs in audit scope could not be confirmed from primary sources.

V1-offchain: BNB Chain token 0xd17479997f34dd9156deef8f95a52d81d265be9c verification status could not be confirmed; BSCscan fetch was not attempted due to fetch-limit constraints and the DeFiPunkd surfacer noted 'chain not supported by the read API'.
V5: Post-audit drift cannot be assessed without a public source repository to diff against the deployed or audited codebase.

protocol_metadata.about: USDD (Decentralized USD) is an over-collateralized decentralized stablecoin pegged 1:1 to the US dollar, primarily issued on TRON with bridged ERC-20 tokens on Ethereum and BNB Chain. Users mint USDD by locking collateral assets in a Collateralized Debt Position (CDP) model. The protocol expanded to Ethereum and BNB Chain in 2025 and also introduced a yield-bearing token sUSDD in October 2025.
